description: This file provides services for product data handling, including fetching products from backend or mock data, normalizing product information, filtering for instant or organic products, checking backend availability, simulating restock, and adding products to cart.

methods.name: normalizeProduct
methods.description: Normalizes product data from backend or mock, extracting organic, stock, and instant flags.

methods.name: fetchProducts
methods.description: Fetches products from backend API or falls back to mock data; supports search and category filtering.

methods.name: fetchInstantProducts
methods.description: Returns only instant-delivery products with additional derived fields, sorted by discount and popularity.

methods.name: getOrganicProducts
methods.description: Fetches products filtered to isOrganic, with optional organicCategory filter.

methods.name: getFeaturedOrganic
methods.description: Returns a small list of featured organic products for teasers.

methods.name: isProductsBackendMode
methods.description: Probes if the backend API for products is reachable, with caching.

methods.name: simulateRestock
methods.description: Simulates restocking by adjusting stockQty in mock mode.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to cart via backend API or returns a mock object.
